derived_semantics.NO_RESULT: started work with one exact terminal record whose kind is NO_RESULT
derived_semantics.NO_RESULT_NOT_ABSENCE: NO_RESULT is an explicit terminal assertion and is distinct from a missing terminal record
derived_semantics.NO_RESULT_NOT_FAILURE: NO_RESULT records terminal absence of result material and does not by itself classify failure cause
derived_semantics.RESULT: started work with one exact terminal record whose kind is RESULT
derived_semantics.RESULT_NOT_SUCCESS: RESULT records produced result material and does not imply correctness, acceptance or success
derived_semantics.RUNNING: started work with no terminal record
derived_semantics.UNREGISTERED: absence of a started-work binding for the work identity

invariants.text: Every RESULT work identity is already started.
Every NO_RESULT work identity is already started.
No work identity is both RESULT and NO_RESULT.
The exact started-work binding for one work identity is immutable after first start.
Terminal work metadata is unique and immutable.
Absence of a terminal record never implies NO_RESULT.
Terminal work cannot be started again, ended again with conflicting metadata, or reopened; a subsequent attempt uses a fresh work identity.
Worker state transitions create no Authority or effect permission and do not themselves create a Seed Resolution.
Worker lifecycle transitions are required to preserve the pinned Seed projection; mechanical Seed refinement remains an open assurance gate for this semantic revision.

defines: one immutable terminal record of kind RESULT or NO_RESULT
fresh identity for a subsequent productive attempt

requirements.text: Implementations MUST recognize only the lifecycle UNREGISTERED -> RUNNING -> TERMINAL, where the exact terminal kind is RESULT XOR NO_RESULT for one work identity.
START_WORK MUST bind a fresh work identity to one exact immutable Worker binding and one exact opaque work-descriptor binding; descriptor internals are profile or implementation concerns.
The exact started-work binding MUST be immutable after first start; exact replay MAY be idempotent and conflicting reuse of the work identity MUST be rejected.
END_WORK MUST apply only to exact RUNNING work and MUST bind the exact started-work digest.
END_WORK MUST create exactly one immutable terminal record whose kind is RESULT or NO_RESULT and whose exact terminal binding is bound to that kind.
NO_RESULT MUST be represented by an explicit exact terminal record and MUST NOT be inferred from absence of a terminal or result record.
Terminal work MUST NOT return to RUNNING; any subsequent productive attempt MUST use a fresh work identity. Retry or predecessor relationships, if any, are outside the Worker lifecycle canon.
Worker capability, execution, result and evidence MUST NOT create Authority, Seed Resolution, recognized Context mutation or external effect permission by implication.
No human, AI model, runtime, tool, solver, robot, provider or other Worker implementation has normative precedence.

semantic_objects.terminal_record: Exact immutable terminal record of kind RESULT or NO_RESULT, bound to the exact started work.
semantic_objects.work_binding: Exact immutable binding established by START_WORK for one work identity.
semantic_objects.work_descriptor_binding: Opaque exact binding to profile- or implementation-defined work description. The Worker canon does not interpret its internal structure.
semantic_objects.worker_binding: Opaque exact identity of the productive source. Worker type and implementation are non-normative.
